rawFindings.title: Auth error handling inconsistent and missing error details in 'do_auth' method
rawFindings.explanation: The previous code called the auth_callback with the error, but the new code only emits a new Error with 'Auth error: ' prefix, losing the 'command_used' property and error type; this can break error handling logic expecting detailed error information on auth failure.
rawFindings.suggestion: Modify the error emission code in 'do_auth' to preserve the original error object and its properties or ensure it has the expected 'command_used' property set before emitting it, matching previous behavior for error callbacks.
rawFindings.failureAfterChange: When authentication fails (e.g., invalid password), error events are emitted without the 'command_used' property and with a generic error message, causing caller error handlers that expect 'command_used' to fail or misbehave.

rawFindings.title: 'do_auth' method emits 'Auth failed' error on non-OK response
rawFindings.explanation: Added explicit check for auth response inequality to 'OK' and emit an 'Auth failed' error; this was missing, so any non-OK response other than errors would not cause an error to be issued, potentially masking auth failures.
rawFindings.suggestion: Keep the added check to emit error on non-OK response to properly propagate authentication failures when the server responds with unexpected reply.
rawFindings.failureAfterChange: If server replies with auth result other than 'OK' (e.g., 'FAIL'), an error event 'Auth failed' is emitted correctly; previously such cases did not emit an error.

rawFindings.title: Change to success callback invocation in 'do_auth' sends original error instead of null
rawFindings.explanation: The success callback now receives (err, res) where err can be non-null (previously always null). Callback code expecting null error on success might need to handle this properly.
rawFindings.suggestion: Consider passing null as the first argument when calling auth_callback on success to maintain previous semantic of null error on success.
rawFindings.failureAfterChange: Callbacks passed to auth() may receive a non-null err argument on success, potentially triggering error handling incorrectly.

rawFindings.title: Removed setting 'command_used' property on error in 'return_error'
rawFindings.explanation: The patch removes the line that sets 'err.command_used = command_obj.command.toUpperCase()' which test code expected; this can break tests or error handlers relying on that property to identify the command causing error.
rawFindings.suggestion: Restore the setting of 'command_used' property on error objects passed to callbacks to maintain compatibility with existing error handlers and tests.
rawFindings.failureAfterChange: Auth failure and other command errors do not have 'command_used' property set in the error object, causing assertions or error management to fail.
